swing_up_lift — DRIVE kendama op

• Data kinds: table → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.swing_up_lift(kp: 'dict', *, apex_above_cup: 'float' = None, T_lift: 'float' = 0.15, g: 'float' = None) -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import kendama; kendama.swing_up_lift(kp: 'dict', *, apex_above_cup: 'float' = None, T_lift: 'float' = 0.15, g: 'float' = None) -> 'float'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("swing_up_lift"))

Usage

Closed form for the lift amount of the swing-up (bang): the lift that puts the ball's apex apex_above_cup above the center of the receiving cup (the inverse of swing_up_apex). apex − lift − cup_z = tie_z + lift/2 − L + 2 lift²/(g T²) − lift − cup_z = A, taken as a degree-2 equation in lift, positive root. Default A = max(h_c + 0.9 r_b, (top_offset − cup_z) + r_b + 0.035): an apex where the bottom of the ball clears the highest point of the kendama by 35 mm (the hold of catch_plan_staged does not bring the cup closer until the ball has cleared it; during the clearance time ≈ 2√(2·0.03/g) = 0.17 s the cup is moved back sideways by 10 cm). Unless the deceleration 4·lift/T² exceeds g, the ball does not fly (ValueError).
